notes:
### One Channel Extension Flow

- One Channel timed checks can now extend in place without restarting playback: 30 min prompts at 25 min for 1 h, 1 h prompts at 55 min for 2 h, and 2 h prompts at 115 min for Unlimited.
- The 2 h -> Unlimited prompt uses a 15-second timeout. With no response, playback continues to the exact 2 h boundary, then kodi.log is saved and Shutdown is executed.

### Channels Check Settings

- The top Auto Channels Check selector now switches between 2 h and Unlimited, while Site Check and IPTV Check remain the actual check toggles. Unlimited applies to One Channel only.
- Multi-channel 1 h / 2 h checks keep the existing +5-minute verification tail; One Channel uses exact 30/60/120-minute boundaries.

### Unlimited Log Handling

- Unlimited + Save Log Only now overwrites one persistent Adult TV Test Unlimited.log after every manual stream stop and stays armed for later streams in the same Kodi session. A new Kodi session overwrites the same existing file on its first stopped stream.
- Unlimited + Shutdown remains unchanged.

### Important

- Dorcel playback, shadow recovery, SOURCE_WINDOW handling, live-delay behavior and handoff logic are unchanged from v1.150.
